req.title: Task description optional
req.statement: The system shall accept POST /tasks/ payloads without a description field.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-017 requires that POST /tasks/ accepts payloads without a description field. Three test cases are designed: (1) a positive EP test sending only 'title' (no description key at all) and asserting HTTP 201 with description=null in the response; (2) a negative NEG test sending a payload with no title (required field missing) to confirm HTTP 422 is returned, proving the server validates required fields and the 2xx path is not trivially open; (3) a BVA boundary test sending description=null explicitly (the boundary between omitted and present-but-null) and asserting HTTP 201 with description=null. Together these kill mutations that: remove the Optional typing on description, change the status code constant, flip validation logic, or alter the null-handling path.

tests.name: test_create_task_without_description_field_returns_201
actions: POST /tasks/ with JSON body containing only 'title' key (no description key)
trace: R-TASK-017: system shall accept POST /tasks/ payloads without a description field
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.database import engine
from app import models

models.Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=engine)
models.Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)

client = TestClient(app)

def test_create_task_without_description_field_returns_201():
    payload = {"title": "Buy groceries"}
    r = client.post("/tasks/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert isinstance(body["id"], int)
    assert body["title"] == "Buy groceries"
    assert body["description"] is None
    assert body["completed"] is False
    assert "created_at" in body

test_create_task_without_description_field_returns_201()

tests.name: test_create_task_title_only_then_retrieve_description_null
preconditions: POST /tasks/ and GET /tasks/{task_id} endpoints are available
actions: Assert description is null in GET response
expected: POST returns HTTP 201 with description null
GET returns HTTP 200 with same id and description null
description persisted as null in database
trace: R-TASK-017: description optional; state transition from created to retrieved preserves null description
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.database import engine
from app import models

models.Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=engine)
models.Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)

client = TestClient(app)

def test_create_task_title_only_then_retrieve_description_null():
    payload = {"title": "Persist null desc"}
    post_r = client.post("/tasks/", json=payload)
    assert post_r.status_code == 201
    created = post_r.json()
    assert created["description"] is None
    task_id = created["id"]
    get_r = client.get(f"/tasks/{task_id}")
    assert get_r.status_code == 200
    fetched = get_r.json()
    assert fetched["id"] == task_id
    assert fetched["description"] is None
    assert fetched["title"] == "Persist null desc"

test_create_task_title_only_then_retrieve_description_null()
